title: Witness and Alibi
author: Ulyana Montrose
blurb: August Eriksen, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
